meta.source: TibiaTools damage API (https://tibiatools.io/api/v1), as used by tibiapal.com/damage-calculator

requests.note: one /damage response covers every spell of the vocation

meta.note: avg/min/max = raw damage per hit per target before crit, creature resistances and mitigation.
meta.levelTerm: g(L) = L/5 to 500, then +1 per 6 levels to 1100, per 7 to 1800, per 8 to 2600, per 9 above

models.weapon: const + levelTerm*g(L) + skill*S + attack*A + skill*attack*SA [+ levelSkillAttack*g(L)*S*A/1000] (attack = weapon + ammo)

rules.flatBonus: raw += bonus * variant.bonusFactor (per hit, per target, before crit); bonusFactor equals the variant level multiplier
rules.baseDamagePct: raw = levelPart + (raw - levelPart) * (1 + pct/100), levelPart = bonusFactor * g(L) (the level term is not boosted); probes: ratio 0.100 +- 0.003
rules.crit: effective = raw * (1 + chance * extra); spell crit perks and the character "Critical hit extra damage" perk add to chance/extra
rules.creatures: effective *= damageMods[element] * (1 - creature.mitigation/100); physical additionally reduced by armor (~7 % for Demon)

Ascetic.note: at 5 harmony assumed by the API

Lord of Destruction.scope: fire spells, Master of Flames stance

rules.targets: API summary per turn = per-hit effective * targets of the rotation entry

critDefaults.note: tibiapal default: Powerful Strike imbuement; expected multiplier 1 + chance*extra

healing.name: Mass Spirit Mend
healing.note: linear level (not levelTerm); Scaled by Harmony in game.
